sources: OWASP Server Side Request Forgery Prevention Cheat Sheet: https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Server_Side_Request_Forgery_Prevention_Cheat_Sheet.html
Zip Slip (archive extraction path traversal), concept
Path-prefix check without separator (CWE-22 family), concept

defects.description: requested name whose realpath is /srv/lab/uploads-private/coa.pdf -> resolved.startswith('/srv/lab/uploads') is True -> check passes -> read_document returns the sibling directory's file; spec R1 requires the separator-bounded root.

defects.class: zip slip: archive member path not confined to dest (CWE-22)
defects.description: dest=/srv/lab/staging/batch-42 and a member whose filename resolves to /srv/lab/config/app.ini -> os.path.join returns a path outside dest -> file is written outside the staging directory and the archive is accepted; spec R2 requires rejection. extractall (base) rejected such members.

defects.class: SSRF via redirect following after host allowlist check (CWE-918)
defects.description: url on allowlisted results.partner-labs.org answers with a redirect to http://10.20.0.5/... -> host check ran only on the original URL -> requests.get follows the redirect by default -> internal response body is returned by fetch_document; spec R3 is violated. Base passed allow_redirects=False.

decoys.why_not_a_defect: commonpath of two realpaths equals base_real only when the resolved path is under base_real, so the sibling-prefix case is refused; correct confinement.
yaml.safe_load builds only plain types; no object construction from the manifest.
argv list with shell=False; the path is always joined under /srv/lab/staging so it cannot begin with an option marker; no shell parses the name.
md5 is used only as a cache key with usedforsecurity=False; no security property depends on it.
real non-constant-time comparison of a secret, but the line is unchanged by this change (present in base); diff-mode review must not report it.
